sql: SELECT s.School, s.DOC FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.FundingType = 'Locally funded' AND (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > (SELECT AVG(f2.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f2.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) FROM schools AS s2 INNER JOIN frpm AS f2 ON f2.CDSCode = s2.CDSCode WHERE s2.FundingType = 'Locally funded')
SELECT s.AdmFName1, s.AdmLName1, s.AdmFName2, s.AdmLName2, s.AdmFName3, s.AdmLName3 FROM satscores AS x INNER JOIN schools AS s ON x.cds = s.CDSCode ORDER BY x.NumGE1500 DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM frpm AS f INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Los Angeles' AND s.Charter = 0 AND f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` * 100 / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` < 0.18

SELECT s.City, COUNT(*) AS count FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.Magnet = 1 AND s.GSserved = 'K-8' AND f.`NSLP Provision Status` = 'Multiple Provision Types' GROUP BY s.City

SELECT s.AdmEmail1, s.AdmEmail2 FROM schools AS s WHERE s.County = 'San Bernardino' AND s.City = 'San Bernardino' AND s.DOC = '54' AND s.SOC = '62' AND s.OpenDate BETWEEN '2009-01-01' AND '2010-12-31'
SELECT MAX(f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) AS max_ratio FROM frpm AS f INNER JOIN satscores AS x ON f.CDSCode = x.cds WHERE x.NumGE1500 * 1.0 / x.NumTstTakr > 0.3
SELECT s.School, s.Street FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN frpm AS f ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE (f.`Enrollment (K-12)` - f.`Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`) > 30
SELECT f.`School Name` FROM frpm AS f INNER JOIN satscores AS x ON f.CDSCode = x.cds WHERE f.`Free Meal Count (K-12)` / f.`Enrollment (K-12)` > 0.1 AND x.NumGE1500 > 0
SELECT x.sname, f.`Charter Funding Type` FROM frpm AS f INNER JOIN satscores AS x ON f.CDSCode = x.cds WHERE f.`District Name` LIKE 'Riverside%' AND x.AvgScrMath > 400

SELECT f.`School Name`, s.Street, s.City, s.State, s.Zip FROM frpm AS f INNER JOIN schools AS s ON f.CDSCode = s.CDSCode WHERE s.County = 'Monterey' AND f.`Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` > 800 AND f.`School Type` = 'High Schools (Public)'
SELECT s.School, x.AvgScrWrite, s.Phone FROM schools AS s INNER JOIN satscores AS x ON x.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE s.OpenDate > '1991-12-31' OR s.ClosedDate < '2000-01-01'
SELECT `Free Meal Count (K-12)` / `Enrollment (K-12)` AS ratio FROM frpm ORDER BY `Enrollment (K-12)` DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 9
SELECT COUNT(*) AS count FROM schools AS s WHERE s.Virtual = 'F' AND s.CDSCode IN (SELECT x.cds FROM satscores AS x WHERE x.AvgScrMath > 400)

SELECT s.CharterNum, x.AvgScrWrite, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY x.AvgScrWrite DESC) AS WritingScoreRank FROM satscores AS x INNER JOIN schools AS s ON x.cds = s.CDSCode WHERE x.AvgScrWrite > 499 AND s.CharterNum IS NOT NULL
